title: Up-date..It's now not working very good!! Sealed good, bags can go in Freezer, has recharger.
text:
Up-date..It's now not working very good!! Sealed good, bags can go in Freezer, has recharger.. UP-DATE. I have been using this for a couple of months, although not often, and a full Charge only lasted a couple of times before having to recharge again!.
Also this might not work like it should , as It takes a long time to get the air out of the bags with a full charge!
I have used this type of vacuum sealers before, so I know how to use this.
I gave this a 4 star, now I'm dropping it down to a Two star.
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
When I got this it did not take long to charge it up.
This comes with a wall recharger, a few 1 qt. bags, and a little plastic thingie to seal the zip down. Actually its kind of handy.
Since these bags go into the freezer there heavier bags.

I used it on the Nesco bag that comes with this, and it Sucked the air out real good. Also glad these bags can go in the freezer.
I also tried it on one of the other food saver bags I have that are the same size, 1 Qt. It worked on those bags also, which I'm happy about,
as I have quite a few of those left.

I like this Nesco sealer. Its heavier then my other two, Food saver, that did not last long!
Hopefully this will take the place of my larger Vacuum Sealer, which is a pain to use, and a big waste of allot of plastic.
I do not know if the Nesco bags are BPA free etc.!!!

After using this two times in a row, I plugged it in to recharge, and the light was Red, it took about 15 mins to
recharge this for the Green light to come on, which let me know it was fully recharge..
Before I used it , it was sitting unplugged for a couple of days. I didn't expect this to need a recharge so fast!!

I hope this last me longer then the other sealers I had!
The Nesco is also heavier and hopefully stronger sealing then the food saver.
So far so good.
If there is a problem with this,I will come back with a up-date.

product_metadata.title: Nesco VS-09HH, Handheld Vacuum Sealer, White/Green
features: High capacity, rechargeable battery seals up to 50 bags per single charge
Heavy duty motor and piston pump
Charger and stand included for convenient use and easy storage
Works with Nesco Hand Held Vacuum Sealer Bag models VS-10HB and VS-11HB
description: The NESCO VS-09HH Handheld Vacuum Sealer is the perfect tool to save time and money! Prepare whole meals in advance & save leftovers. Eliminate freezer burn, reduce spoilage and waste. The Nesco Handheld Vacuum Sealing system is great for keeping your expensive deli meats, cheeses and other perishables fresh longer. It can protect important documents, jewelry or other valuables. It takes up minimum storage with its compact design and is easy to use. Ideal for SOUS-VIDE cooking. It's so small it can easily be brought on trips to seal liquids from spilling onto your luggage and comes complete with a charging cord and reusable bags. The Nesco system works with Nesco Handheld Vacuum Sealer Bags (models VS-10HB and VS-11HB). Includes 4 small (7.87" x 9.06") reusable bags, charger cord and charger stand.
